svg.title: How Sheets is built
svg.desc: A React and TypeScript desktop UI talks to a Rust core through Tauri's typed IPC commands. The Rust core has five parts: Session: Edits, one undo step per action; notes, charts and filters; IronCalc engine: ~490 functions, recalculation, .xlsx reading and writing; Recovery: AutoRecover every 30 s, crash recovery, version history; Storage: .xlsx, .csv and .tsv; encoding detection; atomic saves; Updates: Background checks; signed, verified installs. Storage reads and writes plain .xlsx and .csv files on your disk; Updates fetches signed releases from GitHub.
